changes: Carry the existing bounded retained-research catalog through the AQL artifact handoff to the final Zopedia evidence reader, including quiet or disabled optional-investigation runs.

Separate the configurable inline history size from readable reports: the store catalog is bounded at 100, while 20 recent summaries remain inline by default. No complete retained report is inserted inline.
Preserve source captures, original research dates and artifact identities when a retained finding supports a published story. Reject future-dated artifacts at the input boundary.
Preserve current candidate observations across the observed universe so publication outside the new investigation list can use current ticker metadata.
Clarify issuer/segment, category/component, period and forecast comparison reasoning in shared research/review, and allow source-grounded corrections to a fallible writing outline.
Require concrete developments and practical business consequences with distinct public fields in the existing shared writer.

offline_handoff.meaning: Input availability and provenance only; no new model output or quality acceptance.

operational_checks.scope: Numerical, current observation, date, source preservation, reader and provider contracts; no prose grades.

legacy_suite.meaning: The 26 older agent tests fail on unchanged pre-fix Git source too. They include removed helper names and obsolete prompt/behavior expectations. They were not changed to manufacture acceptance.

comparison_protocol.inputs: Pin the same recorded dataset versions, completed pre-run artifacts and captured source content for both complete flows. Preserve each source implementation’s own planner and writer. No rejected experiment becomes historical knowledge.
comparison_protocol.model: Full production Pro with the same reasoning setting and provider price band.
comparison_protocol.same_exclusions: No new live intraday collection, narration or independent optional page generation in either comparison. Do not call these core-flow costs the whole production bill.
comparison_protocol.inspection: Personally inspect complete Briefs and all stories, financial scope/comparison, continuing useful coverage, numerical discoveries, concrete explanation and omissions. Do not force example-company inclusion.
comparison_protocol.accounting: All baseline, candidate, failed and interrupted requests count in the same original study ledger; preserve the earlier $12.203458 estimate and $2.292450 unresolved maximum.
comparison_protocol.authorization: Additional $10 API exception requested to raise the existing cap from $15 to $25. No new paid request or cap mutation before explicit approval.

deployment: No build or development/production deployment. Local output acceptance is still pending.
qualification_limits: The readback proves retained reports are available, not that the model selects or interprets them correctly.
Runtime defaults changed; no fresh quality claim is made from operational checks.
publication_boundary: Expose complete canonical research, semantic review corrections and original source captures to the reader/publication, excluding internal agent execution traces.
